text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
About three years have passed since Furioso
came to the Central Tracen Academy on a special study program...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At first, she didn't have any Umamusume friends, but... over these three years, the situation changed.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Furio.
I've got a very special photo here.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: What kind of photo is it, Tran-san?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I was chatting with a friend in America earlier, and they sent me photos of rare creatures, but among them...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: There were even photos of rare crayfish.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: A crayfish!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You used to like crawfish, right?
I thought you might want some data... Whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want it so badly I can practically taste it...
However, I have nothing to offer in return...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll make this one on the house.
Because, well...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's me and Furio. We go way back.
It's a give-and-take kinda thing.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "between Furio and me"...?
There's a deep divide between JRA and Funabashi...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you say so, Tran-san...
I'll gladly take you up on your kindness this time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you'd better know what's coming, Furioso.
We're training together right now! And once we're done—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"We're buying out all the lollipops!
Limit five per person. Line up, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Limited quantities again, is it?
Nothing can be done about it, then...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It is not as if I can go whenever you ask.
Only this once, alright?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Heh! You say that every single time."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-saaan!
I brought you another invite to our live show!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I really want you to come.
Every time, your cheers reach my heart better than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally.
Having accepted the invitation, I will not hold back.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: If I am summoned, I shall cross the divide between Funabashi and the JRA to pay you a visit.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furioso didn't have any friends at first, but...
choice_data_list: You've been getting invited out a lot lately, huh?
You've been getting invited out a lot lately, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...? Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I think it was pretty normal, personally.
More like I just happened to be there."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's not true. Furioso-san might seem a bit hard to approach at first glance, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone says she's actually
a really easy girl to get along with, too."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Not only is she easy to hang out with, she's quiet,
considerate, always keeps her promises...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone says we're
really good friends, though♪"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Such... a truly wonderful friend...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...That hurts. To think an assassin from Funabashi
would receive such an appraisal...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san, I'm sorry to trouble you, but
could you gather everyone for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a mysterious summons went out—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The hell, Furioso?
You guys fixin' to go jump somebody together?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "I actually had a gadget I wanted to show you, Furio~. Wanna play around with it before we head out?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to tease you.
I have something to tell everyone today.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: This is very important, so please listen.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Why so formal all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone has the wrong idea.
Listen to me carefully: I am—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I haven't been swayed!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been swayed by sentiment at all.
I draw a clear line between Funabashi and the JRA.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We are not "good friends,"
so please, do not forget that.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Excuse us, then.
Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Furioso turns her back
on her friends, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Not swayed, huh?
There it is, your usual line.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"There's no need to be so stubborn.
Right, Espo-san?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that "swayed by sentiment" crap?
Doesn't make any damn sense.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-saaan!
See you later, then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Furioso remained stubborn as ever. Yet, her Central
peers simply laughed off her attitude with good cheer."
